correctness.rationale: The beta posterior moments preserve the polynomial filtration and give diagonal entries n falling k divided by (n+c) rising k, where c=a+b+2. Selfadjointness and rank give the stated trace for every s>0. The log-product bound gives a compact-uniform Gaussian tail past n^(3/5). For h=n^(-1/2), t=h(k+(c-1)/2), the first three logarithmic sums give -t^2+h^2[(c-1)^2/4+ct^2/2-t^4/6] with a summable O(h^3(1+|t|^5)) logarithmic remainder on the window. Exponentiation there is uniform; the squared correction and remainder sum, with the Gaussian weight, to O(h^2). Euler–Maclaurin from the shifted starting point (possibly negative) gives the boundary coefficient 1/2-(c-1)/2 and no order-h boundary term because the Gaussian derivative at zero vanishes. Integrating the three correction monomials gives the stated coefficient. As a separate exact check, for c=1 and s=2 Vandermonde gives T=1/2+binom(4n,2n)/(2 binom(2n,n)^2), matching both the half-unit boundary term and correction factor 3/16 by Stirling. The argument is compact-uniform, not uniform at s=0 or for unbounded parameters.
residual_risks: Finite packaged checks are corroboration only; no formal verification was performed.
